title: Composite knowledge and portfolio evaluation system
objective: Integrate the strongest mechanisms from the frozen feature/evals-A through feature/evals-N family without duplicating the canonical knowledge graph, weakening public-safety boundaries, or allowing agents to impersonate external evidence.

branch_family.mechanism: separated launch, portfolio, and knowledge contracts
composition, role-evidence, mosaic-privacy, and system-risk controls
application and production profiles with diagnostic and closure separation
responsive, accessibility, visual-proof, and observer-integrity evidence
lexicographic optimization and independent blind-reader protocol
application cadence and broad launch integration
source-specific run traceability and independent hybrid grading
release rehearsal, mutation attacks, review locks, and reader compression
canonical graph, corpora, policies, maintenance, and strict knowledge gates
claim-development and projection-candidate separation with explicit application argument
append-safe intake, query, report, and exact-surface operator ergonomics
modular gates, governed-open states, and five-minute hiring review
P0, P1, and P2 release triage
human evidence, outcome transfer, current capability, visual proof, and recursive method

composition_profiles.reader_decision: choose a proof path or resume
select the most relevant case study

composition_profiles.audience: technical project and product operations hiring readers
composition_profiles.reader_decision: connect capabilities to projects and proof
view or download the approved resume

composition_profiles.audience: readers seeking Jamie's practice and continuity
composition_profiles.reader_decision: understand the artistic, civic, and technical throughline
make contact through an approved path

external_gates.next_action: Obtain project-relevant collaborator review of the exact candidate.
Run the unprimed hiring-reader protocol on the exact candidate.
Record a bounded non-identifying application-response sample.
Complete photo-editor selection plus rights and consent review.
Deploy only after Jamie approves the exact candidate, then capture DNS, TLS, smoke, indexing, and rollback evidence.

selection_order: public-safety, privacy, factual-integrity, and collective-credit failures

anti_gaming: Do not delete evidence, claims, routes, qualifiers, anti-claims, or accessibility affordances to improve a score.
Do not convert a protocol, recollection, source mention, platform metric, chronology, or current authenticated view into completion, endorsement, impact, causality, or lifetime coverage.
Do not hide Jamie's supported agency behind vague team language or erase collaborators to make Jamie more visible.
Do not expose protected sources, private paths, raw text, authenticated state, contact data, or uncleared media.
Do not let an optimizing agent provide its own independent score or human approval.
